verdict.rationale: Supabase publishes a documented Management API as an OpenAPI 3.0 spec at supabase.com/openapi.json, covering organizations, projects, branches and configuration. A probe confirmed the spec is live (HTTP 200), and llms.txt surfaces it explicitly under 'API and agent resources'. It also documents auto-generated REST/GraphQL data APIs, an API-key model for scripts and servers, and Advisors that agents can pull via the Management API. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the Management API programmatically, and in-depth evidence of endpoint coverage and auth scopes (PATs currently require all scopes).
